verified.notes: Packed tarball 0.1.0 installed into an owned, disposable, non-Desktop web profile (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1). This release migrates the plugin to the v3 POC data model. The parser reads identity + gate0 + plan + progress[] + outcome; the four dimensions come from `outcome`; the progress stream is a new core view; the gap rule set grew from 8 to 12 (R1-R12); and the stat strip is now POC总数 / G0通过 / 进行中 / 金额合计. The v3 numbers were verified against the real ledger data first: 23 projects, 6050万 total, 1 G0 passed, 0 G0 complete, R1 on all 23, R2 on 7 — matching the update note's acceptance list exactly. dsh --profile <test> --dump-config composed the row; a bounded real startup served the Web app; the authenticated transport exercised the exact /api/skillre-work-dashboard/execute route (cold cache empty, manual refresh cloned the ledger, board computed v3 summaries and gaps, detail returned the progress stream, a second refresh used fetch + reset --hard, unknown project and unauthenticated request failed cleanly), and cleanup removed the owned profile with verified absence. The real DSH Web UI was then driven in headless Chromium: 43/43 assertions passed, including the seven-column v3 table, the amount column, the latest-progress column, the progress-stream section, four separate dimension cards, the twelve-rule pending list, and a new guard that no raw template placeholder reaches the DOM. Two real defects were caught during that verification and fixed: gap TITLES were rendered through t() instead of format() so parameterised titles leaked literal {amountWan}; and the detail identity line still carried the removed v1 {tier} key. The export form is deliberately hidden in this release: it still models v1 fields, and shipping it would hand colleagues YAML the v3 ledger cannot read. It is preserved at src/form.v1-deferred.ts for the P1 rewrite. The published 0.2.0 market entry was then verified end to end: the LIVE hosted index listed 工作看板 0.2.0, its own install spec (git+https://github.com/skillre/dsh-plugin-work-dashboard#42b7c9f2bf951cdd1715feda48b47bf81286bc0c) was installed into a fresh owned profile, --dump-config composed the row, a bounded startup served the app, and list/detail/risks/timeline all answered (detail correctly reported unknown-project on the cold cache). Cleanup removed the owned profile and verified it was gone.
verified.note: Packed tarball 0.6.0 installed into an owned, disposable, non-Desktop web profile (DSH 0.2.2-rc.2). This release is a packaging and CI correction, not a feature change: the plugin behaviour verified in 0.5.0 is unchanged. scripts/preview.mjs and scripts/prepare-release.mjs now import the shared scripts/display-contract.mjs instead of each carrying a drifted local copy of the rules, and package.json#files gains the explicit "!docs/PREVIEW.md" exclusion. That closes a real leak: the published 0.5.0 tarball shipped docs/PREVIEW.md, the internal whiteboard registry holding Feishu document links and tokens, because the local reimplementation of npm file selection treated a directory entry in files as an allow-list rather than as contributing ignores. Coverage is now decided by a real npm pack probe, so the repository check, prepare-release and the fleet audit share one verdict and cannot disagree with npm. Two CI defects were also fixed, both of which were failing on main: the plugin.spec cache roots were built from TMPDIR, which runners set to /tmp and which is shallower than the three-segment floor the mount guard enforces (the guard is correct, the fixture was not), and tests/view.spec.tsx failed all 41 assertions on Node 26 because Node 26 defines its own globalThis.localStorage stub that shadows the jsdom Storage vitest would otherwise install. Both were reproduced and re-verified on real Node 26 (41/41 failing before the fix, 41/41 passing after). Verification for this release: npm run check passes (preview check, typecheck, 189 unit tests, lib-drift, pack check); 31 isolated checks passed against the packed tarball on a genuinely mounted DSH 0.2.2-rc.2, including that the three bundled skills reached the skill catalog at boot; cleanup removed the owned profile and its cache and the removal was verified. Desktop Client (Electron) visual verification was not performed for this release; the UI assertions recorded from 0.5.0 still describe the same shipped client bundle.

observations.desktopClientNote: The Web UI was verified directly. The Electron Desktop Client shares the same renderer but was not launched for this release; a Desktop-specific visual check remains outstanding.
observations.chartsWithoutDependency: Every figure is hand-built SVG or flex geometry because the client bundle may only externalise `react`. No charting dependency was added.
observations.displayContract: Adopted: locale meta.detail + one preview image per language + docs shipped in the package (evidence excluded).
observations.updateMechanism: The package has never been published to the npm registry (verified 2026-11-13: the registry returns 404 for the package document and for every version). It is therefore not updatable in place today, and the market index does not list it: the fleet builder only emits npm-sourced entries, so the plugin was dropped from the hosted index when the entries were rebuilt. Publishing requires a first publish, which npm cannot bootstrap through Trusted Publishing because a trusted publisher cannot be attached to a package that does not exist.
observations.npmChannel: Blocked as of 2026-11-13: `npm whoami` returns 401 against the local session, so `release:bootstrap` reports "the npm session is missing or expired" and cannot perform the first publish. The protected npm-publish environment, the NPM_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_READY variable and the OIDC workflow are all already provisioned and verified; only the first publish and the subsequent npm trust configuration are outstanding, and both require an interactive human 2FA confirmation.
